name: Generic Jonin

entries.name: Hard to Hit
entries.text: While standing and unrestrained, attacks against you suffer a 1d6 penalty unless adjacent to 2+ enemies.

entries.name: Superior Skill
entries.text: Add 1d6 to checks with proficient skills. In contested checks, add 2d6 instead.

entries.name: Superior Power
entries.text: Twice per turn, add your level (14) to damage instead of your ability modifier.

entries.name: Limitless Potential
entries.text: Twice per encounter, add 1d6 to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

entries.name: Cunning Action
entries.text: Can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

entries.name: Evasive
entries.text: On a successful Dex save, take no damage and suffer no effects.

entries.name: Chakra Weapons
entries.text: Your weapons are considered chakra-enhanced. Gain +2 to hit and damage.

entries.name: Ranged Weapon Expert
entries.text: Gain +1 additional ranged/thrown weapon attack per Attack action (already factored in).

entries.name: Battle Tested Skills
entries.text: Weapons are chakra-enhanced and gain +2 to hit/damage. Also grants 1 extra ranged/thrown weapon attack per Attack action.

entries.name: Well-Rounded Elite
entries.text: Cannot roll ability checks or saving throws at disadvantage.

entries.name: Tabula Rasa
entries.text: At the start of your turn, choose one benefit until your next turn: • +1d4 to attack rolls • +1d6 to damage rolls • +1d8 to skill checks

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Make 3 attacks, or 4 attacks with a ranged or thrown weapon.

entries.name: Kunai (Melee)
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 6) piercing damage.

entries.name: Kunai (Ranged)
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, range 30/60 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 6) piercing damage.

entries.name: Elite Action
entries.text: Takes 1 Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn to move, attack, cast a jutsu, or gain an extra reaction. Regains all Elite Actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries.text: When the Generic Jonin fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead.

notes: Legendary Resistance printed "When Jenrique fails a saving throw, he may choose to succeed instead", a leftover character name; transcribed generically.
